name: Microsoft Cloud Datacenter Region - Qatar Central
notes: Microsoft announced the Qatar Central cloud datacenter region as live in Doha/Qatar; physical facility details and capacity were not disclosed.

name: Google Cloud Doha Region
notes: Google Cloud announced its Doha region as open; the source confirms cloud-region service availability but not specific campus location or power capacity.

name: Ooredoo Qatar Data Centre facilities
notes: Ooredoo's Qatar Data Centre service page describes five data centres and over 60,000 square feet of space; exact municipal distribution and MW capacity are not stated.

name: Qatar Central Bank and Data Center
notes: AEB lists the Qatar Central Bank and Data Center as a completed Doha project; no IT-load capacity was found.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 5
notes: MEEZA announced the launch of its fifth M-VAULT datacenter in Qatar; MEEZA's QSTP/Education City cluster is treated as Rayyan for this batch. Source did not provide a MW figure.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 4
notes: MEEZA and Microsoft announced the launch of M-VAULT 4 in Qatar; the release ties the facility to Qatar's cloud services expansion but does not state capacity.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 4 expansion
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported that MEEZA completed a 4MW M-VAULT 4 expansion for a major hyperscaler.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 7
notes: MEEZA's 2025 annual report describes M-VAULT 7 as an advanced-design project with 16MW capacity, targeted for operation in 2027.

name: Q Data QFZ hyperscale data centre facilities
notes: Ooredoo announced Syntys' acquisition of Q Data Facilities, describing two data centres within Qatar Free Zones with total connected capacity of 12.5MW and expansion potential to over 40MW. QFZ's principal zones include Ras Bufontas and Umm Alhoul; assigned to Wakra for batch coverage.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 2 - Umm Garn
notes: MEEZA's M-VAULT 2 datasheet identifies the site as Umm Garn, about 10 km from Al Khor, and describes it as a Tier III certified data centre. Capacity in MW was not stated.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 6 - Umm Garn
notes: MEEZA's 2025 annual report states that M-VAULT 6 at Umm Garn was 88 percent complete as of year-end 2025 and expected to be handed over in Q1 2026; no MW capacity was found in the cited source.

name: QNB Data Center - Lusail Tower
notes: JEPA describes a 650 kW data center project for QNB in Lusail Tower; Lusail is assigned to Daayen for this batch.
